notes.title: LeaderBIRD update
notes.notes:
As we extend to some more platforms, we wanted to make sure that our leaderbirds were not fragmented across them. As we release Oculus, mobile and PSVR, the leaderbird will be one and the same.

This means that if you don't update, your scores will be submitted to steam's leaderBOARD. For the next couple of weeks, we'll be constantly pulling that data into our own leaderBIRD, but at some point that data will be lost.

As well, our vive users have been getting slightly more tired than our oculus users. They've had to flap harder and stronger, and that's just not fair. We've decided to increase the flap sensitivity for the vive specifically to address that.

notes.title: Update - Music Option and Community Puns
notes.notes:
- Hoshi82, one hell of a flapper (currently 4th on the leaderboard), requested the ability to disable the game music during hardcore bird training sessions. The option is now above the difficulty option. Thanks Hoshi82!

- Puns are important, especially to birds. Its a small thing, but there is now an author above the puns that show up. Send us puns and we'll put them in along with your name or whatever you want to be authored as! :)

Let the journey continue!

notes.title: Update - A few quick fixes
notes.notes:
Just a few little fixes to improve the experience.

- You don't have to fly as high in the beginning to start flying forward.
- The score on the right hand side should no longer jitter.
- There was a little bird...i mean bug... where if you flew through a pipe but then died, you'd get an extra point. No more EXTRA POINTS!
- You were able to spam buttons to have the screen fade in/out after you squashed into a pipe. Fixed!

notes.title: Update - Default Difficulty changed to Peregrine
notes.notes: After a whopping 1 hour on steam, the first update is live. The default difficulty was previously chicken and now its peregrine.
